en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad city square bordered by multi‑storey historic buildings. A clock‑towered church or town hall rises on the left side, while trees and people with carriages occupy the open square. Hungarian text is printed above and below the image, and there are Hungarian stamps and postal cancellations. The reverse side has printed Hungarian wording for postcard use, handwritten address lines, and a circular postmark from Pécs dated 1900.
